title: Compare holdout and knowledge cells in the knowledge report
action: Follow the Contract for kom-2 in docs/history/knowledge-outcome-measure/plan.md. bee knowledge report keeps measured, unmeasured and the evidence ladder and gains outcomes: per arm (knowledge, holdout) the counts cells, blocked, reopened, red_rounds, with_mistakes plus rates (3 decimals), unrecorded, min_per_arm 30 and comparable. Population: capped or dropped cells under .bee/cells (archive included). Arm: knowledge_arm on the earliest dispatch.jsonl row with source prepare, kind cell and that cell id; none means unrecorded. Signals from trace: blocked_reason non-empty string, reopened_for_rework or reopened_at non-null, attempts non-empty, mistakes non-empty. Missing files or bad rows are skipped. Text output adds one line per arm and a too-few line when not comparable. Write the tests first and watch them fail.

truths: bee knowledge report JSON carries outcomes with per-arm counts and rates
A cell with no recorded arm counts as unrecorded and in neither arm
Open cells are excluded from the population
comparable is false until both arms reach 30 cells
measured, unmeasured and the evidence ladder are unchanged

checks.evidence: report.rs:376-427 build_outcomes builds arms.{knowledge,holdout}.{cells,blocked,reopened,red_rounds,with_mistakes,rates{...}}, unrecorded, min_per_arm 30 and comparable. report.rs:367-372 computes each rate rounded to 3 decimals, or 0 when cells is 0. report.rs:442,453 put it into the JSON result. Tests knowledge_outcomes.rs:102 (exact counts and rates: 0.25 and 0.5), 132 (0.333), 147 (an empty arm gives 0.0); passed.

report.rs:340-350 takes the first source=prepare, kind=cell row per cell id. A missing key gives "", which matches no arm, so report.rs:380-383 adds 1 to unrecorded and continues. Test knowledge_outcomes.rs:102 has u1: its prepare row has no key, while a herding-run row and a gather row do; the test asserts unrecorded==1, k=4, h=2. Test :157 (no dispatch log) gives unrecorded 2 with 0 cells in both arms. Both passed.

report.rs:315-337 closed_cells reads .bee/cells/*.json and .bee/cells/archive/<dir>/*.json, which matches the real layout, and keeps only status capped or dropped (report.rs:332). In the tests, o1 (claimed, with a knowledge prepare row and blocked_reason) and o2 (open) are not counted (knowledge_outcomes.rs:79-80,107), and c3 (open) is excluded at :157. Passed.

report.rs:411 sets comparable = every arm has >= MIN_PER_ARM (30), and report.rs:412-418 adds the 'not comparable ... N more knowledge, M more holdout' line. Test knowledge_outcomes.rs:169: 30 knowledge and 29 holdout give false, and 30/30 gives true. Tests :197 and :210 cover the text lines. All passed.
